model_name: AutoCX EV Battery State of Health (SOH) Estimator
training_dataset: NASA Ames PCoE Li-ion Battery Aging Dataset (34 commercial 18650 cells)
validation_strategy: Held-Out Physical Cell Validation (test set comprises entirely unseen battery cells)
target_variable: soh_percent (% of cell initial reference capacity)
limitations: Trained on laboratory cycle life data from commercial 18650 Li-ion cells under controlled discharge conditions.
Predictions reflect cell-level electrochemical degradation kinetics and do NOT certify a complete vehicle battery pack (e.g., Tata Nexon EV).
Diagnostic accuracy depends on physical sensor telemetry. In the absence of live CAN-bus/BMS data, estimations are labeled experimental.
A low SOH estimate alone does not imply complete pack failure; module rebalancing or cell replacement may restore pack integrity.
